article.title: Interaction Nets
article.abstract: The article introduces Interaction Nets (INs), a graph rewriting system that encodes computations in a graph of nodes. It allows for parallelism and captures all computable functions without external machinery like garbage collectors.

newConcepts.definition: A graph rewriting system that encodes computations in a graph of nodes. It allows for parallelism and captures all computable functions without external machinery like garbage collectors.
The process of transforming graphs to represent computational steps, enabling the modeling of computations in a structured and efficient manner.
The ability to perform multiple computational steps simultaneously, enabling efficient and scalable computation.
A widely used language for technical documentation, APIs, and software development.
